question:
The following pie charts show the data of the number of appeared and passed student of class 12 in sections A, B, C, D and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74781db5c88b77fb544c0e8135f1037c16bd8363209f7d1851af4a37771388db.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c78a9179800c1dbeab9d9a093035e01535d024ffcc352c79ec44648097a4d02c.png] 

What is the percentage of students who appeared for the exam in section E (correct to one decimal place)?
solution:
**Calculation**

360° → 100%

1° → 100/360 = 5/18

The students who appeared for the exam in section = 58°

⇒ 58° → 58 × 5/18

= 16.1%

**The answer is 16.1%**
